title: Programme Terms: The Crop Input Rate a Member's Buying Terms Earn on a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Notice
content:
Where the member's own crop input programme standing earns a rate on the crop input basis, that programme rate stands in place of the rate the notice carries for it. The rate follows the terms the member buys on, because prepaid money is capital the cooperative has had the use of all season, and it is read from the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| What stands on the member's crop input accounts | Crop input rate |
| --- | --- |
| a crop input account on the Early Pay Prepay Program Account programme with a prepay balance still standing on it, and a crop input account standing active | 0.02 in the dollar, that is two cents in the dollar |
| a crop input account standing active, and no prepay balance standing on the early pay prepay programme | 0.0165 in the dollar, that is one and sixty-five hundredths of a cent in the dollar |
| no crop input account standing active at all | the rate the notice carries for the crop input basis |

**Both limbs of the first line.** A prepay balance must still stand on the early pay prepay programme and a crop input account must stand active. Where a prepay balance stands but no crop input account stands active, the first line does not hold and neither does the second, and the rate the notice carries for the crop input basis is the one that applies.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical records

| Prepay balance on the early pay prepay programme | A crop input account standing active | Crop input rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 14000.00 | yes | 0.02 |
| none | yes | 0.0165 |
| 14000.00 | no | the rate the notice carries |
| none | no | the rate the notice carries |

**Worked.** A restated crop input volume of 20000.00 earns 400.00 at 0.02 in the dollar and 330.00 at 0.0165 in the dollar. The difference between the two lines of the table is therefore a real one on a Membership and Patronage Equity notice of any size.
